column1: # proj4j gie/GIGS conformance - expected-outcome manifest (SEED / ILLUSTRATIVE).
# THIS FILE IS NOT THE REAL MANIFEST. The real one is generated - see README.md in this
# directory. The keys below are hand-written examples with FABRICATED content hashes; they
# will not match any assertion produced by an actual run. Its purpose is to (a) pin the file
# format in a test, and (b) carry the triage text for the ten quarantined GIGS files forward
# to whoever generates the first real manifest.
# One line per assertion that is NOT expected to pass. A key that is absent is expected to
# PASS; there are no PASS rows. Columns are tab-separated:
